items.author: Ravi Sharma
items.text: Danielle laid out a clear scope and was very professional throughout the engagement. She went above and beyond. I will be sure to consider for any future help. Highly recommended!

items.author: Rhonda
items.text: I have worked with Infinite Accounting Services for the last 2 years. Danielle is very through and keeps me informed.  She is always knowledgeable regarding my financial questions. I highly recommend Infinite Accounting Services not only for your taxes but for your entire financial purposes.  Danielle offers bookkeeping services for businesses too.

items.author: Naomi Elsner
items.text: I was fortunate to find Danielle to do my 2019 taxes last year. I trusted her to do them again for my 2020 taxes this year. She is  knowledgeable, professional, and very thorough. I highly recommend her for anyone's tax preparation needs.

items.author: she cooks
items.text: Cannot recommend Danielle highly enough- responsive, patient, professional, very reasonably priced and just generally easy to work with. Filing my taxes has never been easier.

items.author: Seth Gilmore
items.text: I'm always thoroughly satisfied with the prompt and professional services I receive from Infinite Accounting Srvcs!
